cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Don’t Go
cards.instruction: Create reasons another player must stay with you. Never directly ask them to stay.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Before you zip your suitcase, let me wrap that jar of jam.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's already wrapped in my jumper.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. That's your train jumper. We'll need to unpack it and find something else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you haven't tasted it. I'll get a spoon before you decide.

mechanism: A uses packing expertise to turn each solved jar problem into another necessary check, delaying departure without directly asking B to remain.
confusable: Ordinary helpful packing differs because A corrections perpetually create another B obligation.
comparison: Soup alternative delays through tasting; this one through sealing and safely rejecting a packed gift.
seedUse: Jam seed supplies jumper wrapping and leave-it solution; S03 should correct a real packing issue while using B attempted exit to require one more check.
